palette.notes: Code: 27 colours on the still, 3 ramps, median hue shift 22 deg, ramp length 7. Peach/pink skin ramp shading to rose, red lips, black choker and hair, pale blonde highlights, hot pink top; white canvas.

lighting: Light from the front-left on the face; skin shades warm (peach to rose to brown) under the jaw and neck; strong white specular dots on lips and eyes.
silhouette: Close-cropped three-quarter face portrait cut off by the canvas edge; blocky black hair masses frame the pale face so the profile reads instantly.

motion.timing: Code: 6.29 changes/s, median hold 66.7 ms (p25 33.3, p75 200); these are brush strokes in a speedpaint, not character animation.

texture: Clean flat pixel clusters, almost no dither (code: dither share 0.0005); jaggy single-pixel lineart in a light skin tone, later filled and overpainted.
camera: Locked screen recording of Aseprite with a custom UI theme; the canvas stays fixed, only the drawing changes.

acting.enters: No character acting: the portrait is drawn from a sketch line, then lineart, then flat fills.
acting.acts: Staging lesson: the viewer watches one area (face, then lips, then hair) get finished at a time, so each beat has a clear focal point.
acting.depth: Flat; the face sits in front of the hair, which is filled last as big black shapes.

techniques: speedpaint timelapse: sketch, lineart, flat fills, shading
warm hue-shifted skin ramp toward rose and brown
lineart drawn in a light skin tone instead of black
big flat black hair shapes for contrast with pale skin
small white specular pixels on lips and eyes
editor theme as the hook (caption: using every Aseprite theme)
feel: white canvas + warm skin ramp + black hair blocks + focal-point-by-focal-point reveal = satisfying build-up
for_fred: Reveal Fred in stages for an intro beat: outline first, then flat fill, then shading and a highlight pop on the eye, each tied to a word. Keep it to one or two seconds; do not reuse it every reel.
